title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles 5% as AI Fever Turns to Fear: Markets Wrap
summary: Weeks of anxiety around the viability of the artificial-intelligence trade erupted into a full-blown selloff, pushing the S&P 500 into a correction and sending investors to the safety of bonds and haven currencies.

title: Anthropic’s IPO Drew More Retail Investor Demand Than SpaceX
summary: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering drew roughly between $115 billion and $120 billion of demand for shares from retail investors, according to a person familiar with the matter, more than the amount sought by them in SpaceX’s debut.

title: Wall Street Regulator Probing Nvidia’s Accounting, Reuters Says
summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating the accounting practices of Nvidia Corp., Reuters reported Friday, as the challenges facing the chipmaker continue to mount in the wake of Jensen Huang’s departure as chief executive officer.

title: Apollo Enlists 13 Wall Street Banks for $9 Billion ADT Debt Deal
summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. has brought in 13 Wall Street lenders for a roughly $9 billion debt package it underwrote for Thrive Holdings Inc.’s acquisition of home security provider ADT Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.

title: US Treasuries Rally as AI Selloff Sends Investors to Havens
summary: US Treasuries soared as mounting doubts over the artificial intelligence trade sent stocks tumbling and investors flocking to haven assets.

title: Asset-Backed Debt Sales Top Post-GFC Record on AI Strength
summary: Sales of asset-backed securities have surpassed their highest level since the Great Financial Crisis for a third straight year, as builders of artificial intelligence infrastructure continue to tap markets for financing and cash-rich insurance firms hunt for high-yielding debt.

title: Canada Stocks Eye Longest Losing Streak Since 2023 on Tech Rout
summary: Canada’s major equities index is on track to fall for seven straight sessions in a broad selloff sparked by technology and commodities stocks on Friday, marking the benchmark’s longest losing streak in three years.

title: ETFs: High Conviction Through Novel Strategies
summary: Inkoo Kang, Executive Director of Tactical Products at ProShares, Ryan Lee, SVP of Product & Strategy at Direxion ETFs, and Corgi's Chief Investment Strategist Jeff Weniger join Bloomberg Intelligence's Athanasios Psarofagis at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. The panel examines the rise of increasingly novel ETFs, from leveraged products to private-market and synthetic exposures, and where the limits of the ETF wrapper may lie. They also discuss investor sophistication, the challenge of turning new products into commercial successes and why education becomes increasingly important as strategies grow more complex. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: How Tokenization Could Change the ETF Market
summary: Giang Bui, Head of Issuer Growth at Securitize, Jason Emery, Head of Product Management at DTCC Digital Assets, and Will Peck, Head of WisdomTree Onchain, join Bloomberg Intelligence's James Seyffart at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. The panel examines how tokenization could expand the utility and distribution of ETFs, from collateral mobility and faster settlement to new ways of reaching global investors. They also discuss where the technology is already gaining traction and how traditional and onchain markets could converge over time. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Share Slide Almost Erases IPO Pop as AI Trade Unravels
summary: Anthropic PBC shares erased much of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors’ faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.

title: Kalshi’s Novel Treasury Perps Hit Delays as Other Bets Expand
ETFs Across the AI Ecosystem
summary: Ryan Issakainen, SVP & ETF Strategist at First Trust, Matt Orton, Chief Market Strategist & Portfolio Manager at Raymond James Investment Management, and Hepsen Uzcan, CEO of Deutsche Asset Management Americas, join Bloomberg Intelligence's Emily Pierce at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. The panel examines whether recent volatility has changed the long-term investment case for AI and where opportunities are emerging beyond the biggest technology names. They also discuss concentration risk, the infrastructure buildout behind AI and how investors are using ETFs to gain more diversified exposure to the theme. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
summary: Gold fell for a fifth day — heading for the biggest weekly decline since March — as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a rout in AI stocks spurred selling across metals markets.

title: Omers Private Capital Chief Exits to Lead Pension-Owned Teranet
summary: Ontario Municipal Employees Retirement System’s head of private capital, Michael Block, is leaving the pension manager to be chief executive officer of Teranet Inc., one of its infrastructure portfolio companies.

title: Fed’s Cook Sees Growing Urgency to Tackle Inflation
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook sees an urgent need for the US central bank to raise interest rates to bring down inflation. Cook said Friday at a conference at Chile’s central bank in Santiago, “Inflation has been above target for more than five and a half years, and every additional day poses greater risk that price- and wage-setters will adjust their inflation expectations upward.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Copper Rout Worsens as AI Selloff Wreaks Havoc in Metals Markets
summary: Copper sank to its lowest level since March after a week of market turmoil fueled by deepening worries about global demand.

title: Argentina Hit Hard by Global Turmoil as Bonds Slip Into Distress
summary: A global flight from risk is catching Argentina at a vulnerable moment, deepening a bond selloff fueled by anxiety over next year’s election and pushing its debt into distressed territory for the first time in two years.

title: Morgan Stanley Sees Aussie Riding AI Storm to Outperform in 2027
summary: The Australian dollar will stand out among developed-market currencies next year as it will reap the benefits of the artificial intelligence buildout, weathering the recent stock selloff, according to Andrew Watrous at Morgan Stanley.

title: SEC’s Daly on a Rapidly Evolving ETF Market
summary: Brian Daly, Director of the Division of Investment Management at the SEC, joins Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Daly discusses the rapid evolution of the ETF market, the SEC’s approach to novel products and why the agency is taking an iterative approach rather than rewriting the rules. He also addresses prediction markets, tokenization, leverage and the resilience of the ETF market structure as the industry expands. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Robinhood’s Quirk on ETFs and the Next Generation of Investors
summary: Robinhood Markets Chief Brokerage Officer Steve Quirk joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Quirk discusses how younger investors are trading through volatile markets, Robinhood’s push toward 24/7 access and tokenization, and the firm’s evolving role in prediction markets. He also details Robinhood’s involvement in Trump Accounts and what the program could mean for a new generation of investors. (Source: Bloomberg)
